summary: iter444 Partner CSV bulk import tested end-to-end. Backend: 27/28 pytest passing (16/16 iter444 core + 11/12 iter444 supplement). Frontend: 5-step wizard renders, download-template-btn / step-1-next-btn / csv-dropzone / upload-csv-btn / bulk-review-table / bulk-input-*-* / confirm-drafts-btn / bulk-photo-studio / bulk-photo-dropzone / needs-photo-*, missing-photo-summary / publish-all-btn / step-4-next-btn all present and functional. Bilingual EN/FR labels + error pills verified. QC missing title_fr surfaces bill96 error under bulk-input-2-title_fr. Confirm creates drafts + advances to photo studio. ONE HIGH-priority backend gap: GET /api/partner-pro/bulk-import/template has NO auth guard — returns 200 to a free-tier buyer (spec requires 403 on all 5 endpoints).

critical.issue: Endpoint has NO authentication/subscription gate. Returns 200 with the CSV template for anonymous callers AND for free-tier buyers. Review spec: 'Any of the 5 endpoints → 403' for non-partner/non-admin. All other 4 endpoints (POST /bulk-import, /confirm, /publish-batch, GET /pending) correctly return 403.

minor.issue: Whitespace-only trailing CSV lines (e.g. 4 spaces after a data-row terminating newline) are parsed as a real row and produce 8+ phantom validation errors (title/category/starting_price/quantity/condition/auction_end_date all 'required'). Real-world Excel/LibreOffice exports frequently contain trailing whitespace. Recommend stripping fully-blank/whitespace-only rows before validation. Repro: file whose last line is only spaces → backend returns total_rows=N+1 with phantom row filled with `_required` codes.

Rejects empty `rows` payload with 400 (validation_error) BEFORE the _require_partner_pro gate runs, so a free-tier buyer sending `{rows: []}` gets 400 instead of 403. Non-empty payloads correctly return 403. Recommend running the auth gate first.

ui_bugs.issue: The red pill labelled '{N} row(s) with errors' actually shows the total ERROR COUNT (sum of all error objects), not the number of rows-with-errors. Example: 1 row with 8 field errors renders as '8 row(s) with errors'. Fix: either rename the key `rowsWithErrors` to `errorCount` or compute `rows.filter(r => (r.errors||[]).length > 0).length`.

publish-all-btn is `disabled` when 0 drafts have photos, so clicking it does nothing — no `publish-result` panel, no `go-to-drafts-btn` ever appears. Recommend allowing the click and rendering the count of pending_photos with a link to Drafts (aligns with spec that Publish result surfaces pending_photos_count). Also, publish-result + go-to-drafts-btn testids never mount unless a batch has been published successfully.

issues: Table is wide — horizontal scroll required to see all columns (city, region, buy_now_price, buyers_premium_%). This is acceptable given the 17-column contract.

action_items: Add `_require_partner_pro(current_user)` (with a `current_user` dep) to `GET /api/partner-pro/bulk-import/template` — currently unprotected.
Backend: strip whitespace-only rows before validation in `POST /api/partner-pro/bulk-import` so Excel-generated CSVs don't produce phantom rows.
Backend: run the partner_pro auth check before Pydantic body validation on `POST /api/partner-pro/bulk-import/confirm` (return 403 before 400).
Frontend: rename i18n key `bulkImport.rowsWithErrors` → `bulkImport.totalErrors` (label mismatches value in `bulk-error-summary`).
Frontend: allow clicking `publish-all-btn` even when no drafts are ready — show the `publish-result` panel with `pending_photos_count` + `go-to-drafts-btn` per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/partner_pro.py line 486 `async def get_csv_template()` takes NO dependencies → no auth gate. All 4 sibling endpoints correctly call `_require_partner_pro(current_user)`.
BulkImportPage.js line 63: `errorCount` is `sum(errors.length)`; but is rendered under an i18n key that says 'row(s) with errors'. Label/value mismatch.
PartnerBulkPhotoStudio uploads to S3 via `utils/uploadListingImage` then POSTs URLs to `/photos` — happy path OK, but no bulk-upload progress indicator and no retry on S3 failure.
Backend `_validate_row` treats blank CSV row as a data row — should filter `all(v.strip()=='' for v in row.values())` first.

rca_of_the_issue.template_no_auth: backend/routes/partner_pro.py:485-490 — `@partner_pro_router.get('/partner-pro/bulk-import/template') async def get_csv_template():` has no `current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)` and no `_require_partner_pro` call. Fix: add the dep and the guard exactly like the other 4 endpoints (e.g., line 572, 697, 819, 922).
rca_of_the_issue.error_summary_mislabel: BulkImportPage.js:63 sums `errors.length` across rows and renders that value via `t('bulkImport.rowsWithErrors', {count: errorCount})`. The i18n string reads '{count} row(s) with errors' but the value counts field-level errors. Fix either the string or the computation.
rca_of_the_issue.whitespace_rows: Backend CSV parser in POST /bulk-import iterates every csv.DictReader row including whitespace-only entries. Filter with `if not any(v and v.strip() for v in row.values()): continue` before appending to preview.
rca_of_the_issue.publish_all_disabled: publish-all-btn is disabled while `readyDrafts.length == 0`. Result panel + go-to-drafts-btn are conditionally rendered on a successful publish-batch response, so if a Partner has ONLY photoless drafts the click never fires and they get no feedback. Recommend always calling publish-batch and rendering the summary.
